title: An AI-native experimental laboratory for autonomous biomolecular operations

summary: Nature论文提出AutoDNA，一个AI原生的自主生物分子工程实验室，面向跨多种仪器的多目标实验，通过模型、实验与仪器协同设计实现AI与自动化系统共同演化。

abstract: Developing artificial intelligence (AI)-native experimental laboratories for autonomous scientific exploration with minimal human intervention represents a long-standing goal. Although autonomous experimental systems are emerging1–4, especially in chemical and materials science, they remain largely confined to domains with singular objectives, well-defined workflows and simple instrumentation. This limitation may reflect an ‘add-on’ architecture that uses AI as a task-specific tool rather than providing it with a global understanding of experiments, especially under engineering-oriented circumstances. Here we present AutoDNA, an AI-native autonomous biomolecular engineering laboratory targeting multi-objective experiments across diverse instruments. Through the co-design of models, experiments and instruments, AutoDNA realizes the co-evolution of AI and the automation system within an end-to-end multi-user framework. The system autonomously orchestrates over 20 types of instruments across more than 11,000 steps to execute core nucleic acid operations including synthesis, transcription, amplification and sequencing, while human intervention is limited to hardware maintenance tasks, such as reagent and labware replenishment. Across four representative applications, AutoDNA matched expert-optimized enzymatic DNA synthesis yields, accelerated concurrent protocol execution by 3.2-fold, completed an end-to-end DNA data storage cycle with exact recovery of the original digital content, and identified and validated a clinically detected KRAS G13D mutation. AutoDNA establishes a blueprint towards science-as-a-service, accelerating biological discovery and advancing various applications in synthetic biology and information storage.
zh_abstract: 开发以人工智能（AI）为原生的实验室，使其能够在极少人工干预下进行自主科学探索，是一个长期目标。尽管自主实验系统正在涌现（1–4），尤其是在化学和材料科学领域，但它们在很大程度上仍局限于目标单一、工作流程明确且仪器简单的领域。这一局限可能反映了一种“附加式”架构：即把AI作为特定任务的工具，而不是让其对实验具备全局性理解，尤其是在面向工程的情境下。在此，我们提出AutoDNA，一个AI原生的自主生物分子工程实验室，面向跨多种仪器的多目标实验。通过模型、实验和仪器的协同设计，AutoDNA在端到端的多用户框架内实现了AI与自动化系统的共同进化。该系统可自主编排20余种仪器、执行超过11,000个步骤，完成包括合成、转录、扩增和测序在内的核心核酸操作，而人工干预仅限于硬件维护任务，如补充试剂和耗材。在四项代表性应用中，AutoDNA达到了专家优化的酶促DNA合成产率，将并发方案的执行速度提高了3.2倍，完成了一个端到端的DNA数据存储循环并精确恢复了原始数字内容，并识别和验证了一个临床检出的KRAS G13D突变。AutoDNA为“科学即服务”（science-as-a-service）确立了蓝图，将加速生物学发现，并推动合成生物学和信息存储领域的各类应用。

abstract: Large language models are increasingly being used to evaluate clinical texts, a concept known as LLM-as-a-judge. However, most of the existing evidence focuses on English data and uses pooled agreement metrics that obscure clinically relevant failure modes. This study audited six open-weight models against expert judges on four German clinical datasets covering report and nursing documentation summarization, discharge summary generation, and patient letter generation. The models were evaluated across three paradigms and four prompt configurations. Alignment with experts varied by criterion and corpus, and no configuration proved reliable across paradigms. All judges exhibited position and identity bias. Substituting LLM-as-a-judge for the expert panel shifted 57.2% of pointwise categories, swapped 41.7% of pairwise winners, missed 10.2% of clinical errors, and inverted clinical priorities by overrating the criteria succinct and accurate. Therefore, LLM-as-a-judge is not a safe substitute for experts in German clinical text evaluations, and deployment thresholds should follow decision-impact analysis for LLM-as-a-judge in clinical contexts.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于评估临床文本，这一概念被称为“LLM作为评判者”（LLM-as-a-judge）。然而，现有证据大多集中于英文数据，并使用会掩盖临床相关失效模式的汇总一致性指标。本研究在四个德语临床数据集上，以专家评判者为参照，对六个开放权重模型进行了审计，数据集涵盖报告和护理文书摘要、出院小结生成以及患者信件生成。模型在三种范式和四种提示配置下接受评估。与专家的一致性因评价标准和语料而异，没有任何一种配置在各范式中均表现可靠。所有评判者均表现出位置偏倚和身份偏倚。用LLM评判者替代专家小组后，57.2%的逐点评分类别发生改变，41.7%的成对比较胜者被调换，10.2%的临床错误被漏判，并且因高估“简洁”和“准确”这两项标准而颠倒了临床优先级。因此，在德语临床文本评估中，LLM评判者不能安全地替代专家，在临床情境中部署LLM评判者的阈值应遵循决策影响分析。

Moreover, ML-based delirium risk models commonly degrade in performance during external validation. To examine the performance of a fusion multimodal with natural language processing (NLP) delirium risk stratification model in live clinical practice with cross-hospital external validation. This quality improvement study evaluated live clinical deployment of the model among patients 60 years or older who were admitted to non-intensive care units at Mount Sinai Hospital (MSH), with external validation performed at Mount Sinai Morningside Hospital (MSM), from December 1, 2024, to December 31, 2025. abstract: [JAMA network open] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots are increasingly used to support maternal health, but randomized evidence is limited. To evaluate whether access to a generative AI maternal health chatbot improved 12-month maternal health outcomes. This 2-group randomized clinical trial enrolled 400 participants from October 2023 to December 2024, with 12-month follow-up completed in December 2025. Participants were recruited online across 49 US states and the District of Columbia. Eligible participants were English-speaking, aged 14 years or older, pregnant or parenting an infant younger than 6 months, and self-identified as members of racial and/or ethnic minoritized groups. Participants were randomized 1:1 to receive access to the chatbot or an active control consisting of monthly children's books. Primary outcomes were anxiety and depression symptoms at 12 months measured using the Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 and Patient Health Questionnaire-9. Secondary outcomes included emergency department visits, pregnancy-related complications, postpartum care checkups, effective contraception use, and sleep duration. Among 400 randomized participants, the mean (SD) age was 32.6 (5.1) years; 200 (50%) were parenting an infant at enrollment; and 10 (2%) identified as American Indian or Alaska Native, 80 (20%) Asian, 188 (47%) Black or African American, 57 (14%) multiracial, and 65 (16%) Hispanic or Latino. The AI chatbot was not associated with differences in anxiety scores (adjusted mean difference, 0.10; 95% CI, -0.77 to 0.96) or depression scores (adjusted mean difference, -0.23; 95% CI, -1.05 to 0.59), nor with emergency department visits, postpartum care, contraception use, or sleep duration. Among participants pregnant at enrollment, the chatbot was associated with more self-reported pregnancy-related complications in the secondary 12-month end point analysis, but not in longitudinal analyses. Higher chatbot engagement was associated with longer sleep duration and higher anxiety scores in exploratory within-group analyses. In this randomized clinical trial of pregnant and postpartum individuals from racial and ethnic minoritized groups, access to a generative artificial intelligence maternal health chatbot did not improve maternal anxiety or depression at 12 months compared with an active control. Secondary and exploratory findings should be interpreted cautiously. ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06053515.

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] The clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) published by the European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) span approximately 1100 pages whose simultaneous cross-referencing is impractical at the point of care. Unguarded large language models (LLMs) carry hallucination risk, motivating a guideline-locked design. We describe the architecture and development of a context-aware clinical agent encompassing the full ESVS corpus of 14 CPGs. The system extends a validated single-guideline GraphRAG prototype with an LLM-driven Guideline Router, an embedded Context Gate that withholds retrieval when decision-critical parameters are absent, dual-channel retrieval, and GPT-5 synthesis under a mandatory citation template. An automated benchmark assessed the final system on 55 vignettes, scored by 2 blinded LLM judges over 3 runs (330 judgments), with clinician adjudication of every flagged claim. The system stayed within its locked corpus, declined all out-of-scope queries, and achieved 98.4% guideline-routing recall. The Context Gate showed 91.9% specificity and 78.6% sensitivity for underspecified queries, and all 259 cited recommendations were verifiable within the locked corpus. Automated judges flagged an unsupported claim in 18.2% of items under a sensitive screening definition; on adjudication by 2 vascular surgeons, 7.3% of items contained a clinically consequential error, none graded capable of causing harm. Clinical acceptability of complete answers was not scored and is reserved for prospective expert evaluation. These results support the feasibility of a multi-guideline context-aware clinical agent for vascular surgery; citation traceability and locked-corpus provenance facilitate future auditability.

abstract: Genomic foundation models are increasingly used to propose DNA sequences and edits. But successful design requires capabilities that current benchmarks do not measure. Here we introduce BEND 2.0 (BENchmark for DNA language models), which tests how well models predict the effects of DNA changes and whether these predictions can guide sequence design. Across eight tasks built on five experimental datasets, we find that model choice and how representations are accessed both affect performance. Linear readouts fitted to frozen representations can match or exceed models' native outputs, and functional post-training substantially improves the models' capabilities. Linear readouts transfer well across experimental assays and genes, suggesting that models capture functional patterns beyond the data used to fit individual predictors. At the same time, strong prediction of average effects can conceal weaker prediction of context-specific effects, and accurate prediction of combined mutation effects does not imply accurate prediction of their interactions. In design tasks, model predictions can reduce the number of candidates needed to find a desired response, but still leave substantial room for better design choices, particularly for context-specific and multi-cell objectives. Our benchmark reveals that genomic models now display signs of general utility but have yet to saturate on performance in even simple tasks.

abstract: Protein-complex structure prediction with AlphaFold 3 depends on MSA content, depth, and cross-chain pairing. Current pipelines apply uniform recipes, typically maximizing depth and pairing by species, yet even whether cross-chain pairing helps AF3 remains contested. We show that the value of both depth and pairing is strongly target-dependent, so no single recipe is optimal across interfaces. We introduce an autonomous agent that treats a frozen AF3 as a black-box experimental instrument. For each target, the agent formulates biological hypotheses, analyzes and reorganizes the MSA, and iteratively refines sequence selection and pairing using predictor label-free signals alone. On 1{,}015 protein--protein interfaces from three benchmarks released after AF3's training cutoff, the agent improves overall interface DockQ over AF3's default pipeline and fixed MSA recipes on every benchmark, while using on average 60\% fewer MSA sequences than the default. Gains are largest for inter-species heteromers, where species-based pairing is unreliable: mean DockQ increases from 0.465 to 0.612 on FoldBench and from 0.482 to 0.562 on HD439. The improvements arise from both sequence construction and pairing policy, including deliberate non-pairing.These results recast MSA design as a target-specific problem and show that an autonomous agent can adapt it at test time through biological reasoning and self-directed, confidence-guided experimentation.

abstract: [Journal of neurosurgical sciences] To evaluate the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) tools on workflow efficiency, treatment times, and clinical outcomes in patients with large vessel occlusion (LVO) stroke. We included observational studies that assessed the implementation of AI-based tools in the management of patients with suspected or confirmed LVO stroke. Eligible studies reported workflow, treatment, safety, or functional outcomes. Data were extracted on thrombolysis rates, CTA-to-arterial puncture time, door-to-puncture time, endovascular treatment (EVT) access, reperfusion success, symptomatic intracerebral hemorrhage (sICH), mortality, and functional independence (mRS 0-2) at 90 days. Random-effects models were applied to calculate pooled mean differences (MD) or risk ratios (RR) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Thirteen studies were included. AI implementation significantly reduced workflow delays: CTA-to-puncture time decreased by -40.20 minutes (95% CI -66.41 to -13.99; P<0.01) and door-to-puncture time by -23.17 minutes (95% CI -38.71 to -7.63; P<0.01). Thrombolysis administration showed no difference (RR 0.79; 95% CI 0.57-1.09; P=0.15). Similarly, no significant effects were observed for EVT access (RR 0.97; 95% CI 0.66-1.44; P=0.89), reperfusion success (RR 1.06; 95% CI 1.00-1.12; P=0.06), sICH (RR 0.63; 95% CI 0.30-1.35; P=0.23), or mortality (RR 0.72; 95% CI 0.38-1.37; P=0.32). However, AI-based workflows significantly improved functional independence at 90 days (RR 1.55; 95% CI 1.12-2.15; P=0.008). AI tools significantly improve treatment times and functional independence in acute LVO stroke without increasing adverse events.

abstract: Deep models for radiological diagnosis are typically trained to predict disease labels directly from images, which limits them to diseases seen during training and makes their decisions hard to interpret in radiologists' terms. Radiology, however, proceeds from visual findings to disease through published guidelines that make this decision rule explicit, interpretable, and reproducible. We introduce diagnosis by composition (DbC), a representation learning framework that encodes this findings-first logic. DbC learns a vocabulary of radiological findings by aligning image features with the text embeddings of the findings, each finding represented as a dense map over the scan. A disease is defined by a set of required findings derived from its guidelines, and its diagnosis map is a fixed, parameter-free composition of the corresponding finding maps. Because the finding-to-disease mapping is derived from guidelines rather than learned, DbC is interpretable and auditable by design, can extend to new diseases by specifying their findings without retraining, and can diagnose unseen diseases by composing their findings. On multi-phase liver CT, DbC detects and localizes unseen diseases, rare diseases from a different institution, and an external cohort significantly better than all comparators, including models that align images with disease names. DbC also improves detection and localization in the fully supervised setting and remains superior across training-set sizes. Although demonstrated on liver CT, DbC applies wherever radiological guidelines define diseases through findings.
zh_abstract: 用于放射学诊断的深度模型通常被训练为直接从图像预测疾病标签，这使其局限于训练期间见过的疾病，也使其决策难以用放射科医生的语言加以解释。然而，放射学是依据已发表的指南，从影像学征象推进到疾病诊断的，而这些指南使决策规则明确、可解释且可重复。我们提出“组合式诊断”（diagnosis by composition，DbC），这是一种编码此种“先征象、后疾病”逻辑的表征学习框架。DbC 通过将图像特征与征象的文本嵌入对齐来学习一套放射学征象词汇表，每个征象表示为覆盖整个扫描的稠密图。疾病由源自其指南的一组必需征象定义，其诊断图则是相应征象图的一种固定的、无参数的组合。由于征象到疾病的映射来自指南而非学习得到，DbC 在设计上即具有可解释性和可审计性，只需指定新疾病的征象而无需重新训练即可扩展到新疾病，并可通过组合其征象来诊断未见过的疾病。在多期相肝脏 CT 上，DbC 对未见疾病、来自另一机构的罕见疾病以及外部队列的检测和定位均显著优于所有对照方法，包括将图像与疾病名称对齐的模型。在完全监督的设置下，DbC 同样改善了检测和定位，并在不同训练集规模下始终保持优势。尽管本研究以肝脏 CT 为例进行了验证，但凡是放射学指南通过征象来定义疾病的场景，DbC 均可适用。

abstract: Automatic tools can now generate whole-brain MRI parcellations at cohort scale, but generated-label releases often provide little evidence about which cases are reliable enough to reuse. We introduce OpenBrain, a confidence-aware release of 35,838 provenance-verified OpenNeuro T1w cases from 607 source datasets. OpenBrain is organized as an auditable case-record release rather than a directory of standalone segmentation files: each record links a primary parcellation, two committee parcellations, source/license provenance, raw QC-7 measurements, percentile risks, a combined risk score R, and a confidence tier. QC-7 is a reference-free reliability panel over label geometry, image-label consistency, and committee disagreement, so users can filter, weight, audit, or re-threshold generated labels without rerunning inference. We evaluate this released evidence under a frozen protocol. Across external cohorts, lower QC-7 risk corresponds to higher generated-label quality; in fixed-budget training, lower-risk selections improve paired macro Dice over random selection by +3.2 to +3.7 percentage points. OpenBrain also exposes raw axes, committee outputs, provenance, and datasheet documentation, so confidence claims remain inspectable after download. It does not turn generated labels into manual annotations or clinical-grade segmentations. Its contribution is a large open generated-parcellation substrate, a reusable case-level risk-evidence layer, and an external validation protocol for release-time QC. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lanqz7766/OpenBrain. Code: https://github.com/lanqz7766/openbrain.

abstract: Saliency maps are offered as a safeguard for medical image classifiers, but whether they reveal individual errors at a new hospital remains largely untested. We trained a convolutional network and a vision transformer on NIH ChestX-ray14 and evaluated 303,768 decisions per model at the training hospital and at two external sites, in the USA and Vietnam, with radiologist-consensus labels. We scored each explanation by its anatomical enrichment, the area-normalized concentration of attribution in a segmented thoracic region, and tested whether it detects errors beyond the model's confidence. Grad-CAM localized findings less often than radiologists (hit rate at most 0.575 versus 0.888). Adding enrichment to a confidence-based error detector calibrated at the training hospital never raised its area under the curve by more than 0.011, and for the convolutional network the relation between enrichment and correctness reversed between hospitals, degrading the transferred detector. Model confidence, not saliency, should anchor deployment monitoring.
zh_abstract: 显著性图被用作医学图像分类器的一种保障手段，但它能否在新医院揭示个体错误，在很大程度上尚未得到检验。我们在 NIH ChestX-ray14 上训练了一个卷积网络和一个视觉 Transformer，并在训练医院以及美国和越南的两个外部站点上，利用放射科医生共识标签，对每个模型评估了 303,768 个决策。我们以解剖富集度（即归因在分割出的胸部区域内按面积归一化的集中程度）为每个解释打分，并检验其能否在模型置信度之外检测出错误。Grad-CAM 对病变的定位频率低于放射科医生（命中率最高为 0.575，而放射科医生为 0.888）。在训练医院校准的基于置信度的错误检测器中加入富集度后，其曲线下面积的提升从未超过 0.011；对于卷积网络，富集度与正确性之间的关系在不同医院之间发生反转，使迁移后的检测器性能下降。部署监测应以模型置信度而非显著性为依据。

title: All-Atom Structure Tokenizer: AtomLM-9b for Biomolecular Structure Prediction
zh_title: 全原子结构分词器与AtomLM-9b结构预测
summary: 提出全原子结构分词器，并基于Qwen3.5-9B训练AtomLM-9b，称结构预测性能可与AlphaFold 3相当。
key_points: 覆盖骨架、侧链、核酸与配体重原子
基于结构token的语言模型，预印本
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，基线对比有限
abstract: We develop an All-atom Structure Tokenizer that compresses biomolecular geometry into discrete structural tokens and achieves high-accuracy all-atom reconstruction. A hierarchical geometric encoder and finite scalar quantization map chemical units to a shared vocabulary of 8,192 tokens, while a joint coordinate de-tokenizer reconstructs backbone, side-chain, nucleic-acid, and ligand heavy atoms. The tokenizer achieves all-atom lDDT scores of 0.832 and 0.835 on CASP14 and CASP15, respectively. Building on this tokenizer, we train AtomLM-9b, an autoregressive language model based on Qwen3.5-9B that predicts structural tokens from molecular identities and connectivity and decodes them into complete atomic structures. We demonstrate, for the first time, protein structure prediction performance comparable to AlphaFold 3 with an all-atom-tokenizer-based structural language model: on the FoldBench protein-protein task, AtomLM-9b achieves a success rate of 75.01%, compared with the published AlphaFold 3 result of 72.93%. These results establish discrete all-atom tokenization as an effective interface between high-fidelity atomic reconstruction and language-model-based structure prediction.
zh_abstract: 我们开发了一种全原子结构分词器（All-atom Structure Tokenizer），可将生物分子几何结构压缩为离散的结构标记（token），并实现高精度的全原子重建。分层几何编码器与有限标量量化（finite scalar quantization）将化学单元映射到包含 8,192 个标记的共享词表，同时联合坐标解标记器可重建主链、侧链、核酸和配体的重原子。该分词器在 CASP14 和 CASP15 上的全原子 lDDT 分数分别为 0.832 和 0.835。在此分词器的基础上，我们训练了 AtomLM-9b，这是一个基于 Qwen3.5-9B 的自回归语言模型，可根据分子身份和连接关系预测结构标记，并将其解码为完整的原子结构。我们首次证明，基于全原子分词器的结构语言模型可达到与 AlphaFold 3 相当的蛋白质结构预测性能：在 FoldBench 蛋白质-蛋白质任务上，AtomLM-9b 的成功率为 75.01%，而已发表的 AlphaFold 3 结果为 72.93%。这些结果表明，离散全原子分词是连接高保真原子重建与基于语言模型的结构预测的有效接口。

title: Deep-Reorder: Refined Motion Correction for 3D Brain MRI via Iterative Data Regrouping.
zh_title: Deep-Reorder：迭代数据重组的3D脑MRI运动校正
summary: 提出利用深度学习重建时间有序k空间片段并迭代重组分组的方法，提高3D脑MRI扫描内运动估计的时间分辨率与校正效果。
key_points: 从非相干采样出发，深度学习重建k空间片段图像
通过配准估计运动，并任意重组shots迭代校正
重组可提高运动估计的有效时间分辨率
reason: 同行评审的新方法，摘要中证据有限，属增量档
abstract: [Magnetic resonance in medicine] Accurate and temporally high-resolution estimation of subject motion is paramount for effective motion-correction in MRI. This work proposes a novel approach for estimating subject motion within a 3D MRI scan with high temporal resolution. Starting from an incoherent sampling scheme, images are reconstructed from temporally ordered k-space fractions via deep learning, enabling motion estimation via registration between each image. Assuming the bulk of the motion is removed using these initial estimates, the remaining misalignment between k-space fractions is expected to be minimally correlated in time. Based on this insight, an iterative strategy is proposed in which shots are arbitrarily regrouped into new k-space fractions, regardless of their original temporal ordering, for subsequent motion estimation and correction. This effectively increases the temporal resolution of the approach, enabling individual correction of all shots. When applied to 3D T1w TFE MRI of the brain, the proposed approach "Deep-Reorder" estimated a unique motion state for all shots, producing significantly better estimations of retrospective motion compared to estimation without iterative data regrouping. On prospectively motion-corrupted scans with intentional head movement by volunteers, the proposed approach consistently improved image quality, producing less noisy images with reduced motion artifacts. In conclusion, the proposed approach, which is free of external tracking devices or navigators, effectively estimated 3D motion and corrected motion artifacts with increased temporal resolution.
zh_abstract: [Magnetic resonance in medicine] 准确且具有高时间分辨率的受试者运动估计对于 MRI 中有效的运动校正至关重要。本研究提出了一种新方法，可在 3D MRI 扫描中以高时间分辨率估计受试者运动。该方法从非相干采样方案出发，通过深度学习由按时间顺序排列的 k 空间片段重建图像，并通过各图像之间的配准来估计运动。假设利用这些初始估计已消除了大部分运动，则 k 空间片段之间残余的错位在时间上应具有极小的相关性。基于这一认识，提出了一种迭代策略：将各次激发（shot）不考虑其原始时间顺序而任意重新分组为新的 k 空间片段，用于后续的运动估计与校正。这有效提高了该方法的时间分辨率，使得能够对所有激发逐一进行校正。在应用于脑部 3D T1w TFE MRI 时，所提出的方法“Deep-Reorder”为所有激发估计出各自独立的运动状态，与不进行迭代数据重新分组的估计相比，对回顾性运动的估计显著更好。在志愿者故意移动头部的前瞻性运动污染扫描上，该方法持续改善了图像质量，得到噪声更少、运动伪影减轻的图像。总之，所提出的方法无需外部跟踪设备或导航回波，即可有效估计 3D 运动并校正运动伪影，同时提高了时间分辨率。

title: Adversarial robustness of deep learning-based thyroid nodule segmentation in ultrasound.
zh_title: 超声甲状腺结节分割的对抗鲁棒性
summary: 针对超声甲状腺结节分割，设计两种黑盒对抗攻击并评估三种推理期防御策略，考察U-Net类模型的鲁棒性。
key_points: 提出SSAA与FDUA两种黑盒攻击
评估随机预处理、去噪和集成推理三类防御
聚焦超声分割模型的安全性
reason: 同行评审但摘要显示单任务、验证有限，属增量档
abstract: [PLOS digital health] Deep learning-based segmentation models are increasingly integrated into clinical imaging workflows, yet their robustness to adversarial perturbations remains incompletely characterized, particularly for ultrasound images. We evaluated adversarial attacks and inference-time defenses for thyroid nodule segmentation in B-mode ultrasound. Two black-box adversarial attacks were developed: (1) Structured Speckle Amplification Attack (SSAA), which injects boundary-targeted noise, and (2) Frequency-Domain Ultrasound Attack (FDUA), which applies bandpass-filtered phase perturbations in the Fourier domain. Three inference-time mitigations were evaluated on adversarial images: randomized preprocessing with test-time augmentation, deterministic input denoising, and stochastic ensemble inference with consistency-aware aggregation. Experiments were conducted on a U-Net segmentation model trained on cine-clips from a database of 192 thyroid nodules. The baseline model achieved a mean Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) of 0.76 (SD 0.20) on unperturbed images. SSAA reduced DSC by 0.29 (SD 0.20), from 0.76 to 0.47, while maintaining high visual similarity (SSIM = 0.94). FDUA resulted in a smaller DSC reduction of 0.11 (SD 0.09), from 0.76 to 0.65, with lower visual fidelity (SSIM = 0.82). Against SSAA, all three defenses significantly improved DSC after correction, with deterministic denoising showing the largest recovery (+0.10, p < 0.001), followed by randomized preprocessing (+0.09, p < 0.001), and stochastic ensemble inference (+0.08, p = 0.002). No defense achieved statistically significant improvement against FDUA, although recall consistently improved at the cost of reduced precision. The tested inference-time defenses therefore partially mitigated spatial-domain perturbations, whereas statistically significant DSC recovery was not demonstrated against frequency-domain perturbations, highlighting attack-specific challenges in adversarial robustness evaluation.
zh_abstract: [PLOS digital health] 基于深度学习的分割模型正越来越多地整合进临床影像工作流程，但其对对抗性扰动的鲁棒性仍未得到充分刻画，超声图像尤其如此。我们评估了B型超声甲状腺结节分割中的对抗攻击和推理时防御。我们开发了两种黑盒对抗攻击：（1）结构化散斑放大攻击（Structured Speckle Amplification Attack，SSAA），其注入针对边界的噪声；（2）频域超声攻击（Frequency-Domain Ultrasound Attack，FDUA），其在傅里叶域施加带通滤波的相位扰动。我们在对抗图像上评估了三种推理时缓解措施：随机预处理结合测试时增强、确定性输入去噪，以及带一致性感知聚合的随机集成推理。实验在一个U-Net分割模型上进行，该模型基于192个甲状腺结节数据库中的电影片段（cine-clips）训练。基线模型在未扰动图像上的平均Dice相似系数（DSC）为0.76（SD 0.20）。SSAA使DSC下降0.29（SD 0.20），由0.76降至0.47，同时保持较高的视觉相似度（SSIM = 0.94）。FDUA导致的DSC下降较小，为0.11（SD 0.09），由0.76降至0.65，视觉保真度较低（SSIM = 0.82）。针对SSAA，三种防御在校正后均显著提高了DSC，其中确定性去噪恢复最大（+0.10，p < 0.001），其次是随机预处理（+0.09，p < 0.001）和随机集成推理（+0.08，p = 0.002）。针对FDUA，没有任何防御取得统计学显著的改善，尽管召回率持续提高，但以精确率降低为代价。因此，所测试的推理时防御能部分缓解空间域扰动，而针对频域扰动未显示出具有统计学意义的DSC恢复，这凸显了对抗鲁棒性评估中存在针对特定攻击的挑战。

title: MedPhysBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models on Medical Physics Calculations and Error Detection
zh_title: MedPhysBench：医学物理计算与错误检测的语言模型基准
summary: MedPhysBench覆盖放疗、诊断影像、核医学和辐射防护的计算题及错误检测题，在1200道留出测试题上评估12个模型，计算得分33.3%至100.0%。
key_points: 十个生成器生成计算题，参考答案由协议代码给出
另设检查题，测试对同事计算表中植入错误的识别
12个模型计算得分差异大，33.3%至100.0%
reason: 新基准、设计规范，但为预印本且规模有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical physicists turn a prescription into a delivered dose and check one another's calculations, because one error in a beam calibration or a monitor-unit (MU) calculation can affect every patient treated with it. MedPhysBench has ten seeded generators of calculation items in radiation therapy, diagnostic imaging, nuclear medicine and radiation protection, up to clinical tasks such as a TG-51 calibration worksheet. Reference answers come from code implementing the governing protocols, and a grader converts units and applies tolerance bands. From the same inputs, separate checking items test error detection, showing a colleague's worksheet or only the colleague's result, half correct and half with one planted error. On a held-out test split of 1,200 items (half for two models), 12 models scored 33.3 to 100.0% on calculation. Of the nine answers graded incorrect for the four best (99.3-100.0%), five contained model errors and four followed NCRP Report 151 on points our items misstate or leave open. Below them, most models did worst on level-3 clinical tasks, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 omitted the inverse-square correction in 19 of 20 isocentric MU items. Five models detected at least 96.7% of mostly large planted errors with at most 4% false alarms; for four of the other seven, checking only the result raised false alarms significantly. In an exploratory targeted test with 20 public cases of an omitted inverse-square correction, the three best models tested caught it in every worksheet, and three weaker models accepted 16 to 18 of 20 planted worksheets, one of them while applying the correction in most of its own calculations. Claude Opus 5.5 accepted 6 of 20 wrong results, although it applied the correction in all 20 of its own. We report the effect of two problems in our shielding items, found after the runs, and release the code, per-item outcomes and targeted-test responses.

title: Personas Are Not People: Identity as State, Not Attribute
zh_title: 人设不是人：身份是状态而非属性
summary: 预印本指出合成人群中以固定人设模拟个体的假设不成立，借助人格研究与身份经济学主张将身份视为随情境激活的状态。
key_points: 合成人群用于问卷预测试与用户模拟
个体跨情境差异大于个体间差异
身份应建模为状态而非固定属性
reason: 智能体社会模拟方向，观点性预印本，档内上调
abstract: Synthetic populations, large sets of simulated people, are increasingly used in place of real people to pretest surveys, simulate users and communities, and evaluate AI systems. Each simulated person is defined by a persona, a written profile of fixed traits, demographics, and attitudes that a language model is instructed to act out. Every such system assumes that a person's identity is a stable attribute that behaves the same way in every situation the simulation presents. We show that this assumption is not a harmless simplification. Three decades of personality research find the opposite. How a given person behaves varies more across contexts than people vary from one another. Drawing on identity economics, which describes how different situations activate different identities and norms within the same person, we separate behavior into three parts, which are stable traits, the identity a context calls up, and the situation itself. We then prove, under two stated assumptions, that any simulation built on fixed personas, no matter how detailed the personas or how large the underlying model, cannot reproduce the part of a population's behavior that is specific to it and its circumstances. We propose a new evaluation criterion based on this result and a person-in-context design that can meet it in principle. We test one version on a naturalistic Reddit personality corpus and on a published clinical-trial recruitment survey of a community with documented distrust of medical institutions. The design does produce context-dependent behavior when tested directly, but in neither setting does it fully match the real population, and we show where it falls short. The consequence for practice is a risk that synthetic-population evaluations misrepresent the groups whose behavior is most shaped by context, a distortion that richer personas cannot correct.

title: From Natural Images to Medical Scans: Transferability of Diffusion Models for Medical Image Generation
zh_title: 从自然图像到医学扫描：扩散模型的迁移性
summary: 系统评估自然图像预训练对医学扩散模型生成的作用，涵盖潜空间与像素空间、131M–952M 参数及两个放射学数据集。
key_points: 自然图像初始化使像素空间 gFID 相对改善21-34%
潜空间改善约14%
收益体现空间结构而非语义
reason: 系统性对比的预印本，有新见解但证据有限
abstract: Transfer learning from natural images is standard in supervised and increasingly adopted in self-supervised medical image analysis, but its role in generative modelling, and in particular diffusion denoisers, remains underexplored. Medical diffusion models typically train the denoiser from scratch, with no systematic evaluation of natural-image transfer. We analyse this across latent and pixel paradigms, model sizes (131M-952M) and two radiology datasets (RadImageNet, BraTS), and ask which aspects of transfer support generation. We find that: i) Natural-image initialisation consistently improves generation, by 21-34% relative gFID in pixel space against 14% in latent space, where the tokeniser supplies much of the prior. gFID gains mirror downstream pathology classification and radiomic-feature FD, both proxies for clinical fidelity. ii) Benefits reflect spatial structure, not semantics: semantic probing does not predict generation quality, whereas a spatial-structure metric adapted to internal denoiser representations tracks gFID at $|r|=0.85$, positioning spatial organisation as a channel through which pretraining manifests. iii) Mixed-domain denoiser training shows that natural and medical images share similar layer-wise representations up to the late blocks, and mixing natural images into medical training improves fidelity. iv) Transfer benefit is tied to natural image initialisation, outperforming in-domain medical pretraining and several reinitialisation schemes. Overall, natural image denoisers transfer positively to medical ones in our setup. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIROLab-Bern/rad-dit
zh_abstract: 自然图像的迁移学习在有监督医学图像分析中已是标准做法，并日益被用于自监督医学图像分析，但其在生成建模中的作用，尤其是在扩散去噪器（diffusion denoiser）中的作用，仍未得到充分研究。医学扩散模型通常从头训练去噪器，尚无对自然图像迁移的系统评估。我们在潜空间（latent）和像素空间（pixel）两种范式、不同模型规模（131M–952M）以及两个放射学数据集（RadImageNet、BraTS）上对此进行了分析，并探讨迁移的哪些方面有助于生成。我们发现：i）自然图像初始化持续改善生成效果，在像素空间中 gFID 相对改善 21–34%，而在潜空间中为 14%，因为在潜空间中分词器（tokeniser）已提供了大部分先验。gFID 的提升与下游病理分类以及影像组学特征 FD 的改善相一致，二者均为临床保真度的代理指标。ii）这种益处反映的是空间结构而非语义：语义探测并不能预测生成质量，而一种适用于去噪器内部表征的空间结构度量与 gFID 的相关性为 $|r|=0.85$，表明空间组织是预训练得以体现的一条途径。iii）混合域去噪器训练表明，自然图像与医学图像在直至后期模块之前具有相似的逐层表征，并且在医学训练中混入自然图像可提高保真度。iv）迁移收益与自然图像初始化相关联，其表现优于领域内的医学预训练以及若干重新初始化方案。总体而言，在我们的设置中，自然图像去噪器可正向迁移至医学去噪器。代码见 https://github.com/CAIROLab-Bern/rad-dit

title: Weight-space programming for auditing clinical decision networks
zh_title: 权重空间编程：用前沿LLM审计临床决策网络
summary: 研究让前沿语言模型仅凭临床协议和小型网络权重，审计并修复放疗申请筛查网络中被植入的缺陷，并在约42万条请求上检验。
key_points: 网络参数量433至4,801，筛查头颈部放疗计划请求
通过训练数据植入混杂、3 Gy阈值偏移与隐藏触发
Claude Opus 5.5盲审，无工具与代码执行
reason: 新颖方法，但为小型网络的合成缺陷，预印本
abstract: Machine learning models in radiotherapy are commissioned by testing them on cases with known answers, which may not reveal a shortcut that the test cases share with the training data. Frontier language models have recently been reported to read and write the raw weights of small neural networks, an ability called weight-space programming. The purpose of this study was to determine whether such a model, given only a clinical protocol and a network's weights, can audit and repair the network. Networks with 433 to 4,801 parameters were trained to screen head-and-neck planning requests against four rules. Flaws were planted through the training data: confounds that hid each rule, a 3 Gy shift in the cord threshold, and a hidden trigger. Claude Opus 5.5 audited each network blind, without tools, data or code execution, and every claim and repair was tested on about 420,000 requests. The language model named the broken rule in 16 of 18 flawed networks (95% CI 67% to 97%), including all 15 with a confound or a threshold shift. It repaired each of the 16 by changing a median of 3 parameters. Fine-tuning on protocol-labeled requests also repaired every network, but changed nearly every parameter. Each confound and shift it found was visible in single units, and a simple statistic chosen for each flaw type found the same flaws. It cleared 2 of 5 healthy networks without being forced and found 1 of 3 triggers. Testing against the protocol detected every flaw, and black-box testing found the confounds and the shift faster. The results indicate that, in small networks, weight-space programming can locate and repair flaws that silence an input or shift a threshold, but cannot yet certify that a network is correct.
zh_abstract: 放射治疗中的机器学习模型是通过在已知答案的病例上进行测试而投入使用的，这种方式可能无法发现测试病例与训练数据共有的捷径。近期有报道称，前沿语言模型能够读取和写入小型神经网络的原始权重，这种能力被称为权重空间编程（weight-space programming）。本研究旨在确定，在仅给定临床方案和网络权重的情况下，此类模型能否对网络进行审计和修复。我们训练了参数量为 433 至 4,801 的网络，用于依据四条规则筛查头颈部放疗计划申请。缺陷通过训练数据植入：掩盖每条规则的混杂因素、脊髓阈值 3 Gy 的偏移，以及一个隐藏触发器。Claude Opus 5.5 对每个网络进行盲审，不使用工具、数据或代码执行，其每项判断和修复均在约 420,000 条申请上进行了检验。该语言模型在 18 个有缺陷的网络中的 16 个中指出了被破坏的规则（95% CI 67% 至 97%），其中包括全部 15 个存在混杂或阈值偏移的网络。它通过平均修改 3 个参数（中位数）修复了这 16 个网络中的每一个。使用带方案标签的申请进行微调也修复了每个网络，但几乎改变了所有参数。其发现的每一个混杂和偏移在单个单元中均可见，并且针对每种缺陷类型选取的简单统计量发现了相同的缺陷。在未被强制的情况下，它判定 5 个健康网络中的 2 个无问题，并发现了 3 个触发器中的 1 个。对照方案进行测试可检出每一个缺陷，而黑箱测试能更快地发现混杂和偏移。结果表明，在小型网络中，权重空间编程能够定位并修复使某一输入失效或使阈值偏移的缺陷，但尚不能证明网络是正确的。

title: High-Resolution Quantitative MRI Using Contrast-Domain Multiscale Energy (MuSE) Regularization
zh_title: 基于对比域多尺度能量正则的高分辨率定量MRI
summary: 预印本提出首个基于扩散模型的0.5 mm各向同性定量MRI重建，扫描不足5分钟，先验用CelebA人脸图像训练，无需MRI训练数据。
key_points: 0.5 mm分辨率，体素体积为临床的八分之一
先验作用于合成对比图像，独立于序列
MuSE模型仅用CelebA灰度人脸训练
reason: 方法新颖的预印本，临床验证有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Quantitative MRI methods can offer tissue parameter maps (e.g. T1) that are comparable across scanners, sessions and subjects, together with multiple contrast-weighted images from a single scan. However, most data are acquired at 1 mm, which limits their use in neurodegenerative diseases that affect fine brain structures. We introduce, to our knowledge, the first diffusion-model-based reconstruction for quantitative MRI at 0.5 mm isotropic resolution from scans of less than 5 minutes, which has eightfold smaller voxel volume than clinical protocols. The key idea is to apply the prior to the synthesized contrast images rather than to the subspace coefficients. The prior is then independent of the temporal basis and the sequence, which improves generalization and allows a 2-D multiscale energy (MuSE) model trained on grayscale CelebA face images to be used without any MRI training data. The explicit energy makes reconstruction MAP estimation by a step-size-free majorize-minimize algorithm that regularizes a rotating subset of contrasts along different axes, which makes 3-D multi-contrast reconstruction tractable. For 3-D radial MPnRAGE at 7 T in 4.3 min, MuSE reduced the phantom NRMSE from 0.133 (CG-SENSE) and 0.091 (L1-wavelet) to 0.074 and the WM T1 interquartile range from 117 and 47 ms to 38 ms, and it was demonstrated in vivo at 7 T.

title: Multi-Objective Generative Optimization via Expected Hypervolume Fine-Tuning
zh_title: 期望超体积微调：多目标生成式优化
summary: 提出Hypervolume Fine-Tuning，微调预训练生成模型以最大化样本期望超体积，用于分子等科学设计中的多目标权衡。
key_points: 同时奖励候选质量与整体权衡覆盖
适配单个预训练流/扩散生成器
约束与预训练分布的偏离
reason: 预印本新方法，面向科学发现，摘要缺少实验证据
abstract: Scientific discovery requires plausible designs spanning useful trade-offs among competing properties: a molecule with strong binding affinity, for example, may be difficult to synthesize. Pretrained generative models, e.g., flow and diffusion generators, provide a foundation for proposing such designs, but steering them toward high-quality, complementary trade-offs remains challenging. Inference-time search incurs high per-sample costs, while fine-tuning typically relies on fixed per-candidate rewards that do not capture how designs complement one another. We introduce Hypervolume Fine-Tuning (HVFT), which adapts a single pretrained generator to maximize the expected hypervolume of its samples while controlling departure from the pretrained distribution. Expected hypervolume jointly rewards candidate quality and collective trade-off coverage. Nonetheless, we show that it cannot be expressed as the expectation of a fixed per-candidate reward and therefore cannot be optimized directly with standard techniques. A key observation of this work is that its first variation corresponds to the expected marginal hypervolume contribution of a candidate, which yields a tractable adaptive reward via an unbiased estimator based on model samples. HVFT uses this reward to decompose the objective into a sequence of KL-proximal scalar-reward subproblems. We establish concavity, relative smoothness, and convergence guarantees for the resulting distributional procedure. Across therapeutic-peptide and molecular design tasks spanning discrete diffusion and continuous flow-matching models, HVFT achieves state-of-the-art expected hypervolume and trade-off coverage.
zh_abstract: 科学发现需要在相互竞争的性质之间实现有用权衡的合理设计：例如，结合亲和力很强的分子可能难以合成。预训练生成模型（如流模型和扩散生成器）为提出此类设计提供了基础，但要引导它们产生高质量、互补的权衡仍具挑战。推理时搜索的单样本成本很高，而微调通常依赖固定的单候选奖励，无法体现各设计之间如何互补。我们提出超体积微调（Hypervolume Fine-Tuning，HVFT），它调整单个预训练生成器，以最大化其样本的期望超体积，同时控制其与预训练分布的偏离。期望超体积同时奖励候选设计的质量和整体权衡覆盖范围。然而，我们证明它无法表示为某个固定的单候选奖励的期望，因此不能用标准技术直接优化。本工作的一个关键观察是，其一阶变分对应于候选设计的期望边际超体积贡献，由此可通过基于模型样本的无偏估计器得到可处理的自适应奖励。HVFT 利用该奖励将目标分解为一系列 KL 近端（KL-proximal）标量奖励子问题。我们为由此得到的分布式过程建立了凹性、相对光滑性和收敛性保证。在涵盖离散扩散模型和连续流匹配模型的治疗性肽和分子设计任务中，HVFT 取得了最先进的期望超体积和权衡覆盖范围。

title: Diffusion Plug-in Priors for Self-Supervised Ultrasound Video Restoration
zh_title: 扩散即插即用先验的自监督超声视频复原
summary: UltraDiff用冻结的预训练扩散模型作先验，无需配对数据或重训练，对超声视频联合超分辨与去散斑。
key_points: 优化扩散采样器潜变量种子，采用MAP形式
基于Rayleigh模型推导散斑感知保真项
无需配对训练数据与网络重训练
reason: 预印本新方法有理论推导，摘要缺少临床验证
abstract: \textit{Objective:} Ultrasound videos are limited by hardware-constrained spatial resolution and signal-dependent speckle, while paired low- and high-resolution acquisitions for supervised restoration are rarely available. We aim to jointly super-resolve and despeckle ultrasound videos without paired training data or network retraining. \textit{Methods:} We propose UltraDiff, which uses a frozen pre-trained diffusion model (DM) as a plug-in prior and restores each frame by optimizing the latent seed of the DM sampler under a range-constrained maximum a posteriori formulation. We derive a speckle-aware data-fidelity term from a Rayleigh scale-family model and characterize its relative-residual and variance-adaptive weighting properties. We further introduce a stabilized fidelity that is bounded below and strictly convex in log intensity for positive observations in its unclamped form. A total-variation regularizer complements the DM prior, and a temporal seed update warm-starts each frame from the optimized seed of its predecessor. \textit{Results:} On EchoNet-LVH videos with simulated speckle and additive noise, UltraDiff with a natural-image prior improves PSNR by 1.24\,dB over the strongest baseline, and ultrasound-related priors improve it further. On real clinical echocardiography videos, UltraDiff reduces the mean absolute error of zero-shot ejection fraction (EF) prediction from 7.31 to 6.37 EF points relative to DUP, the strongest baseline. \textit{Conclusion:} Combining a speckle-aware fidelity with frozen diffusion priors enables ground-truth-free ultrasound video restoration that benefits downstream measurement. \textit{Significance:} UltraDiff needs neither paired data nor retraining and is not tied to a specific diffusion checkpoint. Code associated with this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
zh_abstract: \textit{目的：}超声视频受限于硬件约束的空间分辨率和信号依赖的散斑，而用于监督式复原的低分辨率与高分辨率配对采集数据很少可得。我们旨在无需配对训练数据或网络重新训练的情况下，对超声视频联合进行超分辨率和去散斑。\textit{方法：}我们提出UltraDiff，它将冻结的预训练扩散模型（DM）作为即插即用先验，并在范围约束的最大后验框架下，通过优化DM采样器的潜在种子来复原每一帧。我们基于瑞利尺度族模型推导出一种散斑感知的数据保真项，并刻画了其相对残差和方差自适应加权特性。我们进一步引入一种稳定化保真项，对于正观测值，其未截断形式在对数强度上有下界且严格凸。总变分正则项对DM先验起补充作用，并且时间种子更新使每一帧以其前一帧优化后的种子作为热启动。\textit{结果：}在带有模拟散斑和加性噪声的EchoNet-LVH视频上，采用自然图像先验的UltraDiff比最强基线的PSNR提高1.24 dB，使用超声相关先验则进一步提升。在真实临床超声心动图视频上，相对于最强基线DUP，UltraDiff将零样本射血分数（EF）预测的平均绝对误差由7.31个EF点降至6.37个EF点。\textit{结论：}将散斑感知保真项与冻结的扩散先验相结合，可实现无需真值的超声视频复原，并有益于下游测量。\textit{意义：}UltraDiff既不需要配对数据也不需要重新训练，且不依赖于特定的扩散模型检查点。本工作相关代码将在论文被接收后公开。

title: Mammography datasets and artificial intelligence for breast cancer detection: challenges, bias, and future directions.
zh_title: 乳腺X线数据集与AI乳腺癌检测：挑战、偏倚与未来方向
summary: 综述以数据为中心，分析公开乳腺X线数据集特征及其对AI乳腺癌检测性能与临床泛化的影响。
key_points: 比较公开乳腺X线数据集特征
讨论数据对模型性能与泛化的作用
涉及数据偏倚与未来方向
reason: 有信息量的综述，综述类上限6分，影像专科
abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Breast cancer is still one of the main causes of death in women from cancer worldwide, and early detection is crucial. Mammography is the primary imaging modality for breast cancer screening and recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have significantly enhanced automated breast cancer detection. This review takes a data-centered approach, examining key characteristics of public datasets, the contributions of mammography data to AI for breast cancer detection, and the implications for clinical generalizability. This review, however, takes a data-centered approach, critically analyzing characteristics of publicly available mammography datasets, and the role of mammography data to the development, performance and clinical generalization of AI models for the detection of breast cancer. The datasets are compared on the following aspects: dataset size, quality of the annotations, imaging modality, clinical metadata, dataset accessibility and demographic diversity. Analysis reveals that the quality, diversity and representativeness of the data used are critical for the performance and generalizability of AI models, ranging from the traditional machine learning era to the current era of deep learning, transformer-based systems, multimodal learning, explainable AI and privacy-preserving learning. The results show that, apart from the development of AI model architectures, it is a necessity to have standardized, diverse and clinically representative datasets to make further progress in AI-assisted mammography. The review emphasizes the importance of establishing a comprehensive benchmark dataset for mammography that is large and diverse to enhance reproducibility, to fairly evaluate models, and to develop strong, clinically viable AI systems for breast cancer detection.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 乳腺癌仍是全球女性癌症死亡的主要原因之一，早期发现至关重要。乳腺 X 线摄影是乳腺癌筛查的主要影像学手段，人工智能（AI）的最新进展显著提升了乳腺癌的自动检测能力。本综述采用以数据为中心的方法，考察公开数据集的关键特征、乳腺 X 线摄影数据对用于乳腺癌检测的 AI 的贡献，以及对临床可推广性的影响。本综述以数据为中心，批判性地分析了公开可用的乳腺 X 线摄影数据集的特征，以及乳腺 X 线摄影数据在乳腺癌检测 AI 模型的开发、性能和临床泛化中的作用。数据集在以下方面进行了比较：数据集规模、标注质量、成像方式、临床元数据、数据集可获取性和人口统计学多样性。分析表明，从传统机器学习时代到当前的深度学习、基于 Transformer 的系统、多模态学习、可解释 AI 和隐私保护学习时代，所用数据的质量、多样性和代表性对 AI 模型的性能和可推广性都至关重要。结果表明，除了 AI 模型架构的发展之外，还必须拥有标准化、多样化且具有临床代表性的数据集，才能在 AI 辅助乳腺 X 线摄影方面取得进一步进展。本综述强调，建立一个大型且多样化的乳腺 X 线摄影综合基准数据集十分重要，这有助于提高可重复性、公平评估模型，并开发强大且临床可行的乳腺癌检测 AI 系统。

title: Federated Transfer Learning for Medical Image Classification under Mixed Skew
zh_title: 混合偏斜下用于医学图像分类的联邦迁移学习
summary: 提出PAFP个性化联邦学习框架，基于预训练骨干并加入客户端特定特征对齐模块，应对多中心混合偏斜。
key_points: 针对特征、标签、概念与数量偏斜
基于预训练骨干而非从头训练
客户端特定特征对齐模块
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，证据有限
abstract: Deep learning in medical imaging is constrained by data scarcity and by privacy regulations that make centralizing patient data across institutions impractical. Federated Learning (FL) addresses these constraints by keeping data local, but its distributed nature exposes training to strong statistical heterogeneity. Multicentric medical data is particularly affected, exhibiting a mixed skew that combines feature, label, concept, and quantity shifts across centers. Personalized FL mitigates heterogeneity by tailoring a model to each client, yet most methods assume training from scratch, which is unrealistic given the high dimensionality of medical features relative to the limited data available. We propose the Personalized Aligner Federated Pretrained (PAFP) framework, a personalized FL approach built on a pre-trained backbone. PAFP inserts client-specific Feature Alignment modules before the fine-tuned blocks to realign hidden feature distributions toward a server-aggregated target. On the FedISIC benchmark, PAFP attains the highest unweighted balanced accuracy while reducing inter-client performance variance roughly six-fold relative to the strongest baseline, yielding accuracy and cross-client equity jointly. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Alexandre-Leclercq/PAFP.
zh_abstract: 医学影像中的深度学习受限于数据稀缺以及隐私法规，后者使得跨机构集中患者数据不切实际。联邦学习（FL）通过将数据保留在本地来应对这些限制，但其分布式特性使训练面临强烈的统计异质性。多中心医学数据尤其受影响，表现为各中心之间同时存在特征、标签、概念和数量偏移的混合偏斜。个性化联邦学习通过为每个客户端定制模型来缓解异质性，但大多数方法假定从头开始训练，而鉴于医学特征的高维度相对于可用数据有限，这并不现实。我们提出了 Personalized Aligner Federated Pretrained（PAFP）框架，这是一种建立在预训练主干网络之上的个性化 FL 方法。PAFP 在微调模块之前插入客户端特定的特征对齐（Feature Alignment）模块，以将隐藏特征分布重新对齐到由服务器聚合得到的目标。在 FedISIC 基准上，PAFP 获得了最高的未加权平衡准确率，同时相对于最强基线将客户端间性能方差降低了约六倍，从而同时实现了准确率与跨客户端公平性。我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/Alexandre-Leclercq/PAFP。

title: Molecular Prior Networks
zh_title: 分子先验网络：用于药物-靶点亲和力预测
summary: 受表格基础模型PFN启发，预印本提出一种亲和力建模方法，针对小数据集场景，通过单次前向传播预测查询分子的标签。
key_points: 针对仅数十至数百分子的小数据集
借鉴Prior-data Fitted Networks思路
利用Transformer单次前向完成预测
reason: 新颖方法的预印本，摘要未见充分对比，属值得一看档
abstract: Predicting affinity between small molecules and their protein targets remains one of the central problems in drug discovery. Due to the substantial cost of wet-lab experiments, machine learning models of drug-target affinity are usually trained on relatively small datasets, ranging from tens to hundreds of molecules. Given the inherent difficulty of generalization between different targets and chemical series, existing datasets of protein-ligand affinities are typically not used for new projects. At the same time, tabular foundation models, including Prior-data Fitted Networks, have recently shown how transformers can be used to solve machine learning problems in a single forward pass of the network, after being trained over a large corpus of, typically, synthetic datasets. Inspired by that line of work, we propose a novel affinity modelling approach, in which the labels of the query molecules are predicted from the labelled support molecules in a single forward pass of a transformer model. The model is trained on thousands of existing affinity datasets, enabling it to capture the general patterns of molecular activity across different targets, chemical series and dataset sizes. For the smallest support sets, our model matches the state of the art on the regression variant of the FS-Mol benchmark, while being faster than existing methods, thanks to the lack of task-specific training. A comparison against a reduced variant of our architecture, which amounts to kernel regression in a meta-learned feature space, shows that the predictive performance of the transformer model is only partially explained by simple molecular similarity.
zh_abstract: 预测小分子与其蛋白靶点之间的亲和力仍是药物发现的核心问题之一。由于湿实验成本高昂，药物-靶点亲和力的机器学习模型通常在相对较小的数据集（从数十到数百个分子）上训练。鉴于不同靶点和化学系列之间泛化的固有困难，现有的蛋白-配体亲和力数据集通常不会用于新项目。与此同时，包括先验数据拟合网络（Prior-data Fitted Networks）在内的表格基础模型最近表明，在大量（通常为合成的）数据集语料上训练后，Transformer可在网络的单次前向传递中解决机器学习问题。受这一系列工作启发，我们提出了一种新的亲和力建模方法：在Transformer模型的单次前向传递中，根据带标签的支持分子预测查询分子的标签。该模型在数千个现有亲和力数据集上训练，使其能够捕捉不同靶点、化学系列和数据集规模下分子活性的一般规律。对于最小的支持集，我们的模型在FS-Mol基准的回归版本上达到了最先进水平，同时由于无需针对任务的训练，速度快于现有方法。与我们架构的一个简化变体（相当于元学习特征空间中的核回归）相比，结果表明Transformer模型的预测性能只能被简单的分子相似性部分解释。

title: Disentangling Context-Specific Alzheimer's Disease Progression Signatures through an Explainable AI Framework
zh_title: 可解释AI框架解析阿尔茨海默病进展的情境特异性特征
summary: 提出ADVISE可解释深度生成框架，从人类前额叶大规模单核RNA测序数据中分离Braak分期相关转录信号，识别全局、性别和细胞类型特异的进展特征。
key_points: 用独立潜表示分离分期信号与背景生物学变异
借助可解释AI对基因和通路进行优先级排序
涉及突触传递与HSF1相关蛋白稳态应激等程序

abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) progression involves stage-dependent transcriptional changes that are often masked by dominant cellular and biological variation. Here, we present ADVISE (Alzheimer's Disease Variational Isolation of Signal Embeddings), an interpretable deep generative framework designed to disentangle Braak stage-associated transcriptional signals from background biological variation through separate latent representations. Using explainable AI, ADVISE prioritizes genes and pathways contributing to the disease-specific representation. Applying ADVISE to large-scale single-nucleus RNA sequencing data from the human prefrontal cortex, we identify shared and context-specific signatures of AD progression across global, sex-specific, and cell-type-specific analyses, revealing convergent molecular programs involving synaptic transmission, HSF1-associated proteostatic stress responses, and SLIT/ROBO axon guidance. Notably, ADVISE prioritizes ROBO2 as a progression-associated candidate in excitatory neurons. Experimental validation using CRISPR activation in hiPSC-derived excitatory neurons demonstrates that ROBO2 activation reduces the phosphorylated Tau-to-total Tau ratio. ADVISE thus reveals context-dependent molecular signatures of AD progression and bridges human single-cell discoveries with experimental validation of candidate regulators of AD pathology.

title: XAMPGen: An Interpretable SI Pipeline For Novel Antimicrobial Peptide Discovery
zh_title: XAMPGen：可解释的新型抗菌肽发现流程
summary: 在已知抗菌肽上微调蛋白语言模型ProGen以生成新肽序列，并用探针分类器、回归器和自注意力分析解释模型内部表征。
key_points: 微调解码器型蛋白语言模型ProGen生成抗菌肽
用探针分类器与回归器定位关键层
对这些层做自注意力分析以获得生物学见解
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，可解释性分析，但证据有限，未见实验验证信息
abstract: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are short peptides with a broad spectrum of activity against bacterial pathogens, representing a promising avenue for combating the growing threat of antibiotic resistance. This study focuses on two main components: 1) generating novel AMPs with desired properties using generative SI (GenSI) and 2) utilizing explainable SI (XSI) methods to validate the GenSI model and derive biological insights. In this work, we fine-tuned ProGen, a decoder-only protein language model, on known AMPs to generate novel peptide sequences with strong antimicrobial properties. To advance the interpretability and reliability of the generative model, we applied Explainable SI (XSI) techniques. Specifically, we used a probing classifier and a regressor to identify cornerstone layers that encode functionally critical information. Self-attention analysis within these layers revealed residue level interdependencies and patterns underlying antimicrobial functions, which we validated against well-characterized AMPs from the literature. Overall, these methods provide mechanistic insight into the model's decision-making process, offering a principled basis for trusting the sequences it generates rather than treating the model as a black box. Candidate sequences were filtered based on predicted Minimum Inhibitory Concentration (MIC) along with human insights into the structural activities of the AMPs in bacterial membranes, and a final set of peptides was selected for experimental testing. Biological assays for determining MIC confirmed antimicrobial activity in all generated and tested peptides, with fluorescence and circular dichroism measurements providing structural insight. With our XSI approach, we are able to reveal correlations between amino acid sequence patterns and binding properties of these sequences to bacterial membrane mimics, that directly correlate with biological activities in cell-based assays. This builds confidence in that the learned amino acid interdependencies as applied to AMPs carries physico-chemical meaning and is relevant for discoveries of novel AMPs with therapeutic potential. This work demonstrates that interpretable generative language models can serve as effective and transparent tools for rational AMP discovery.
zh_abstract: 抗菌肽（AMPs）是对细菌病原体具有广谱活性的短肽，为应对日益严重的抗生素耐药威胁提供了一条有前景的途径。本研究聚焦于两个主要部分：1）利用生成式SI（GenSI）生成具有所需特性的新型AMPs；2）利用可解释SI（XSI）方法验证GenSI模型并获得生物学见解。在这项工作中，我们在已知AMPs上对仅解码器的蛋白质语言模型ProGen进行了微调，以生成具有较强抗菌特性的新型肽序列。为提高生成模型的可解释性和可靠性，我们应用了可解释SI（XSI）技术。具体而言，我们使用探针分类器和回归器来识别编码功能关键信息的核心层。对这些层内自注意力的分析揭示了残基水平的相互依赖关系以及抗菌功能背后的模式，并已对照文献中特征明确的AMPs进行了验证。总体而言，这些方法为模型的决策过程提供了机制层面的见解，为信任其生成的序列提供了原则性依据，而非将模型视为黑箱。候选序列根据预测的最低抑菌浓度（MIC），并结合人类对AMPs在细菌膜中结构活性的认识进行筛选，最终选出一组肽用于实验检测。测定MIC的生物学实验证实，所有生成并检测的肽均具有抗菌活性，荧光和圆二色谱测量则提供了结构方面的信息。通过我们的XSI方法，我们能够揭示氨基酸序列模式与这些序列对细菌膜模拟物的结合特性之间的相关性，而这些特性与基于细胞的实验中的生物活性直接相关。这增强了人们的信心，即所学到的氨基酸相互依赖关系应用于AMPs时具有物理化学意义，并与发现具有治疗潜力的新型AMPs相关。这项工作表明，可解释的生成式语言模型可以成为合理发现AMPs的有效且透明的工具。

title: Rho: A Purpose-Driven Workspace for Human-AI Collaborative Analysis
zh_title: Rho：面向人机协作分析的目的驱动工作空间
summary: bioRxiv 预印本，提出Rho人机协作分析环境，按当前科学目的组织材料，作为研究者阅读界面与智能体续接上下文。
key_points: 针对智能体辅助生信中的结果判断瓶颈
组织状态由研究者与智能体共享
摘要主要介绍设计，未见评估结果
reason: 人机协作科学发现系统，预印本，评估信息不足
abstract: Agent-assisted bioinformatics has moved the bottleneck from computing a result to judging it: whether a comparison answers the intended question, on which unit of replication, at which version of the input, and what would change the conclusion. These judgments need materials that are usually scattered across conversations, notebooks, figures, run logs and notes, while the agent's context is a transcript rather than the structure the researcher is actually reading. We present Rho, a human--AI collaborative analysis environment that organizes materials by the current scientific purpose: it selects or obtains the materials a judgment needs, declares the relations they serve, composes operable views, and makes this organization a shared state that is at once the researcher's reading interface and the agent's continuation context. We present the design in three parts: a method object---the operations that form a round-trip, the kinds of state that must stay distinct, and the protocol invariants that make each distinction checkable; a three-layer architecture that separates capability providers from the application that composes them; and five illustrative analyses on public data. In a bulk RNA-seq case the recomputed counts differed from the published counts and the interface kept the computation, the choices and the discrepancy available for inspection; a single-nucleus case makes sample-level replication visible behind a cell-level comparison. Under one configuration these analyses show how the design behaves in practice; we present the work as a design contribution rather than an evaluation, and usability, comparative benefit and the scientific validity of individual analyses remain to be evaluated.
zh_abstract: 智能体辅助的生物信息学已将瓶颈从计算出结果转移到判断结果：某项比较是否回答了预期问题、基于哪一重复单位、针对输入的哪个版本，以及哪些因素会改变结论。这些判断所需的材料通常分散在对话、笔记本、图表、运行日志和笔记中，而智能体的上下文是一份对话记录，而非研究者实际阅读的结构。我们提出 Rho，一种人机协作分析环境，它按当前的科学目的组织材料：选择或获取判断所需的材料，声明这些材料所服务的关系，组合出可操作的视图，并使这种组织成为一种共享状态，同时作为研究者的阅读界面和智能体的延续上下文。我们分三部分介绍该设计：一个方法对象——构成往返循环的操作、必须保持区分的状态类型，以及使每种区分可被检验的协议不变式；一个将能力提供者与组合它们的应用程序分离开来的三层架构；以及基于公开数据的五个示例分析。在一个批量 RNA-seq 案例中，重新计算得到的计数与已发表的计数不同，而界面保留了计算过程、所作选择以及差异，供检查之用；在一个单细胞核案例中，样本水平的重复性在细胞水平比较的背后得以显现。这些分析在同一配置下展示了该设计在实践中的表现；我们将这项工作作为一项设计贡献而非评估来呈现，其可用性、相对获益以及各项分析的科学有效性仍有待评估。

title: MicrobeRT: A Framework and Suite of Fine-tuned Language Models for Genomic Sequences
zh_title: MicrobeRT：用于基因组序列的微调语言模型套件
summary: 基于 Nucleotide Transformer、DNABERT 等预训练基因组语言模型微调，用于宏基因组读段的物种分类、耐药基因检测与致病性评估。
key_points: 覆盖物种鉴定、耐药基因、致病性三任务
基于三个预训练基因组语言模型
面向感染病监测的宏基因组分析
reason: 基因组语言模型微调套件，预印本，验证信息不足
abstract: Accurate and reproducible metagenomic analysis is essential for effective infectious disease surveillance. Targeted diagnostics such as culturing, antigen assays, and multiplex PCR panels identify only predefined organisms and can fail to identify atypical or novel infections. Shotgun metagenomics offers hypothesis-free detection, but adoption is limited by workflow complexity, dependence on mutable reference databases, and high computational cost. To combat these challenges, we introduce MicrobeRT, an integrated suite of genomic language models fine-tuned to classify metagenomic sequencing reads across three tasks: (i) species level taxonomic identification, (ii) antibiotic resistance gene detection, and (iii) pathogenicity assessment. The framework builds on three pre-trained genomic language models - Nucleotide Transformer (Dalla-Torre et al 2025), DNABERT (Ji et al 2021, Zhou et al 2024), and HyenaDNA (Nguyen et al 2024) - leveraging their large-scale genomic pre-training, adaptability to downstream tasks, and, in the case of HyenaDNA, ability to capture long-range sequence dependencies. The models are fine-tuned on large, curated datasets spanning microbial, viral, fungal, and human genomes, including more than 500,000 genomes and 250,000 antibiotic resistance gene sequences. To evaluate the performance of our fine-tuned genomic language models across classification tasks, we developed a benchmarking framework that compares MicrobeRT against state-of-the-art (SOTA) bioinformatics tools. Across both simulated and empirical datasets, the models achieve strong performance while reducing computational overhead. MicrobeRT is released as open-source software, enabling further fine-tuning and reproducible integration of alternative models and classifiers. We also demonstrate seamless, drop-in integration by incorporating our fine-tuned taxonomic classification models as an optional add-on within the open-source TaxTriage pipeline (Merritt et al 2026). MicrobeRT demonstrates the feasibility of three clinically relevant multi-label analyses, offering a practical path to scalable, reproducible metagenomic diagnostics and enabling broader deployment of AI/ML-enhanced infectious disease testing.
zh_abstract: 准确且可重复的宏基因组分析对于有效的传染病监测至关重要。培养、抗原检测和多重 PCR 检测板等靶向诊断方法只能识别预先设定的生物体，可能无法识别非典型或新发感染。鸟枪法宏基因组学可进行无假设检测，但其应用受限于工作流程复杂、依赖可变的参考数据库以及计算成本高。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 MicrobeRT，这是一套集成的基因组语言模型，经微调后可在三项任务中对宏基因组测序读段进行分类：（i）物种水平的分类学鉴定，（ii）抗生素耐药基因检测，以及（iii）致病性评估。该框架建立在三个预训练基因组语言模型之上——Nucleotide Transformer（Dalla-Torre 等，2025）、DNABERT（Ji 等，2021；Zhou 等，2024）和 HyenaDNA（Nguyen 等，2024）——利用它们的大规模基因组预训练、对下游任务的适应性，以及（就 HyenaDNA 而言）捕获长程序列依赖的能力。这些模型在涵盖微生物、病毒、真菌和人类基因组的大型精选数据集上进行微调，其中包括 500,000 多个基因组和 250,000 条抗生素耐药基因序列。为评估我们微调的基因组语言模型在各分类任务中的表现，我们开发了一个基准测试框架，将 MicrobeRT 与最先进（SOTA）的生物信息学工具进行比较。在模拟数据集和实际数据集上，这些模型均取得了出色的性能，同时降低了计算开销。MicrobeRT 以开源软件形式发布，可进一步微调，并可实现替代模型和分类器的可重复集成。我们还通过将微调后的分类学分类模型作为可选附加组件纳入开源 TaxTriage 流程（Merritt 等，2026），展示了其无缝即插即用式集成。MicrobeRT 证明了三种具有临床意义的多标签分析的可行性，为可扩展、可重复的宏基因组诊断提供了切实可行的途径，并有助于更广泛地部署 AI/ML 增强的传染病检测。

title: Omics-scale decoding of protein N-glycosylation using protein language model embeddings
zh_title: 利用蛋白语言模型嵌入解码蛋白N-糖基化的组学尺度研究
summary: 提出零样本框架MaskNGly，借助蛋白语言模型嵌入识别N-糖基化位点，性能可比有监督预测器。
key_points: 基于共进化分析解码pLM嵌入
零样本，无需下游监督训练
可用于蛋白质组尺度糖基化分析
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，基础模型可解释性方向
abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) learn rich sequence semantics from vast volume of protein sequences, yet the information encoded in their high-dimensional embeddings remains largely a black box, posing an interpretability challenge. Here we show that semantic features learned by pLMs can be decoded to reveal biologically meaningful signals using coevolutionary analysis without downstream supervised-training. Building on this insight, we developed MaskNGly, a zero-shot framework that identifies protein N-glycosylation sites directly from PLM-embeddings while achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art supervised predictors. MaskNGly is computationally efficient and intrinsically transferable, enabling omics-scale characterization of protein glycosylation landscape. Applied across proteomes, it reveals that canonical N-X-S/T motifs gain higher glycosylation propensities with increasing organismal complexity and that glycosylation preferentially occurs at structured, solvent-exposed regions. Mutations altering high-scoring motifs are more frequently disease-associated. The framework also captures signatures of glycosylation-mediated protein allostery. These results establish an interpretable and scalable route to study glycobiology from pLM-embeddings.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质语言模型（protein language models，pLMs）从海量蛋白质序列中学习到丰富的序列语义，但其高维嵌入（embedding）中所编码的信息在很大程度上仍是一个黑箱，带来了可解释性方面的挑战。我们在此表明，借助共进化分析，无需下游监督训练，即可对 pLM 所学到的语义特征进行解码，从而揭示具有生物学意义的信号。基于这一发现，我们开发了 MaskNGly，这是一个零样本（zero-shot）框架，可直接从 PLM 嵌入中识别蛋白质 N-糖基化位点，其性能与最先进的有监督预测器相当。MaskNGly 计算效率高，且具有内在的可迁移性，可用于在组学尺度上刻画蛋白质糖基化图谱。将其应用于多个蛋白质组后发现，随着生物体复杂度的增加，经典的 N-X-S/T 基序获得更高的糖基化倾向，且糖基化优先发生在结构化、溶剂暴露的区域。改变高评分基序的突变与疾病相关的频率更高。该框架还能捕捉到糖基化介导的蛋白质变构的特征。这些结果确立了一条可解释且可扩展的途径，用于基于 pLM 嵌入研究糖生物学。

title: Neural RNA splicing models rely on reading frame information unavailable to the splicing machinery
zh_title: 神经RNA剪接模型依赖剪接机制不可用的阅读框信息
summary: 研究发现常用剪接位点预测网络受改变阅读框的突变影响更大，导致系统性漏检毒性外显子。
key_points: 改变阅读框的缺失或突变影响更大
在框内终止密码子产生时尤为明显
毒性外显子被系统性遗漏，具临床相关性
reason: 对模型机制有洞见的预印本，证据有限
abstract: Deep neural networks can accurately predict RNA splice sites from genomic sequence, but whether they do so by simulating the natural splicing process is unclear. We evaluate this question by examining mutations that should not have a strong effect on splicing, but are correlated with it in the human genome. We focus specifically on mutations that affect frame alignment because this is known to be relevant to machinery that operates spatially and temporally separately from the splicing machinery. We find that predictions made by commonly-used neural tools are impacted far more by deletions or mutations that alter translational reading frame, producing in-frame stop codons, than by those that preserve reading frame. This dependence on reading frame causes these models to systematically miss many poison exons, a clinically relevant category of exons where reading frame is disrupted. This dependence is much weaker in "grey-box" models that build in splicing-specific structure. Our results imply that widely-used black-box models of splicing rely on information that is not accessible to the RNA splicing machinery. Code is available at https://github.com/kavigupta/frame-alignment-checks.
zh_abstract: 深度神经网络能够根据基因组序列准确预测RNA剪接位点，但它们是否通过模拟自然剪接过程来实现这一点尚不清楚。我们通过考察这样一类突变来评估这一问题：这些突变本不应对剪接产生强烈影响，但在人类基因组中与剪接相关。我们特别关注影响读码框对齐的突变，因为已知这与在空间和时间上独立于剪接机制运作的机制相关。我们发现，常用神经网络工具的预测结果受缺失或改变翻译读码框、产生读码框内终止密码子的突变的影响，远大于受保持读码框的突变的影响。这种对读码框的依赖导致这些模型系统性地漏检许多毒性外显子（poison exons），这是一类读码框被破坏、具有临床相关性的外显子。在内置剪接特异性结构的“灰盒”模型中，这种依赖要弱得多。我们的结果表明，广泛使用的黑盒剪接模型依赖于RNA剪接机制无法获取的信息。代码可见 https://github.com/kavigupta/frame-alignment-checks。

title: Bridging large language model-based agents and workflow languages for automated multi-perspective analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing data.
zh_title: LLM智能体结合工作流语言实现单细胞RNA测序多视角自动分析
summary: 提出结合LLM智能体与工作流语言的框架，自动生成、验证并并行执行scRNA-seq分析策略并整合报告。
key_points: 生成多种分析策略并转为工作流计划
计划验证使意图满足率由0.061升至0.378
在三个数据集、三种LLM上评估
reason: 新颖智能体方法，有对比，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: [Bioinformatics advances] In single-cell RNA sequencing data analysis, the same dataset can be examined from multiple complementary perspectives, each requiring different analytical strategies and potentially leading to distinct biological interpretations. Systematically exploring such diverse strategies in a reproducible and scalable manner remains challenging. We developed a framework combining large language model-based agents with workflow languages. Given an objective, the framework generates analytical strategies, converts each into a workflow plan, verifies that each plan reflects its intended strategy, executes accepted workflows in parallel, and integrates the outputs into a final report. Evaluation across three datasets and three large language models showed that plan validation improved the executable analysis intent fulfillment rate from 0.061 to 0.378. Diversity of analytical themes was established at as few as 10 generated strategies, while the number of distinct executable analysis paths grew continuously, reaching 59 unique paths at 100 generated strategies. Parallelization of both plan generation and workflow execution achieved up to a 29.9-fold speedup in workflow execution over sequential execution, with plan generation completing in near-constant time regardless of portfolio size. Source code is available at https://github.com/bioinfo-tsukuba/mpdas_paper under the MIT license.
zh_abstract: [生物信息学进展] 在单细胞RNA测序数据分析中，同一数据集可以从多个互补的角度进行考察，每个角度需要不同的分析策略，并可能得出不同的生物学解释。以可重复且可扩展的方式系统地探索这些多样化策略仍具挑战性。我们开发了一个将基于大语言模型的智能体（agents）与工作流语言相结合的框架。给定一个目标，该框架会生成分析策略，将每个策略转换为工作流计划，验证每个计划是否体现其预期策略，并行执行通过验证的工作流，并将输出整合为最终报告。在三个数据集和三种大语言模型上的评估显示，计划验证使可执行的分析意图达成率从0.061提高到0.378。分析主题的多样性在仅生成10个策略时即已形成，而不同可执行分析路径的数量则持续增长，在生成100个策略时达到59条独特路径。计划生成和工作流执行的并行化使工作流执行相比顺序执行最高实现了29.9倍的加速，而无论策略组合规模如何，计划生成均能在近乎恒定的时间内完成。源代码已在MIT许可下公开，网址为 https://github.com/bioinfo-tsukuba/mpdas_paper。

title: SphereFlow: Missing Modality Imputation via Geometric Transport on Hypersphere
zh_title: SphereFlow：基于超球面几何传输的缺失模态插补
summary: 提出SphereFlow，用冻结的自监督编码器将各模态映射到共享超球面潜空间，并用流匹配做几何感知的短程传输来插补缺失模态。
key_points: 将跨模态插补转化为超球面上邻近点间的传输
指出高斯噪声源与线性插值路径和单位范数流形不匹配
针对两类几何冲突做了几何感知修改
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未见医疗场景与验证细节，属增量档
abstract: Missing modality imputation aims to synthesize unobserved modalities from observed ones. Existing methods treat each modality as living on its own latent manifold, forcing the generator to learn a long, unstructured jump between them. We present SphereFlow, which takes a fundamentally different view: by projecting all modalities into a shared hyperspherical latent space via a frozen self-supervised encoder, cross-modal imputation reduces to short-range geometric transport between nearby points on the sphere. Realizing this idea with flow matching, however, exposes two geometric conflicts: the standard Gaussian noise source is catastrophically mismatched with the unit-norm data manifold, and the linear interpolation path departs the sphere surface into a region where the decoder has no training signal. We resolve both with simple, geometry-aware modifications: replacing the noise source with the observed-modality latent so that the velocity field learns only the cross-modal displacement, and training the decoder with a time-weighted loss that extends its domain to the near-surface region traversed by the flow. We prove that this data-as-source formulation reduces the worst-case off-manifold deviation from a quantity that grows with the latent dimension to a small, dimension-independent bound governed by inter-modality similarity. Experiments on BraTS multi-modal MRI imputation and CT-MRI translation demonstrate state-of-the-art generation fidelity across all settings, while downstream brain tumor segmentation with our imputed data closes roughly eighty percent of the gap to the full-modality oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/WTHH031230/SphereFlow.

abstract: [European journal of pediatrics] Artificial intelligence (AI) is reaching pediatric practice through consumer apps, wearables and decision-support tools, yet most children with allergic disease are managed by general pediatricians. This review summarizes what AI can and cannot do across pediatric allergic diseases, emphasising clinical readiness and the questions clinicians should ask before acting on an algorithmic output. Narrative review. MEDLINE/PubMed, Scopus and Google Scholar were searched for English-language publications (January 2015-June 2026) on machine learning, deep learning, digital biomarkers and large language models in pediatric asthma, wheeze, atopic dermatitis, food allergy and allergic rhinitis. Peer-reviewed studies were appraised for clinical applicability, validation status and implementation barriers. Machine learning trajectory analyses show that allergic disease follows multiple coexisting pathways rather than a single atopic march. Deep learning interprets atopic dermatitis images and respiratory sounds with accuracy approaching specialist assessment. Predictive models estimate oral food challenge outcomes and impending asthma exacerbations, and wearable-derived biomarkers may signal deterioration early. Readiness nevertheless varies widely: most applications remain at research or pilot stage, constrained by small single-center datasets, scarce external validation, under-representation of darker skin tones, and limited interoperability with clinical workflows. AI is closer to the bedside in pediatric allergy than in many other areas of pediatrics, but few tools are ready for autonomous clinical use. No trial has yet shown that acting on an AI-derived risk estimate improves clinical outcomes in children. Pediatricians will increasingly encounter AI-derived outputs brought by families or embedded in health systems; appraising validation, representativeness and accountability is becoming a core clinical skill. • Pediatric allergic diseases follow heterogeneous trajectories that conventional tools predict poorly. • AI models report high accuracy in image, audio, and risk-prediction tasks. • Readiness, not reported accuracy, should govern clinical use: most tools remain research-stage. • Pediatricians need a practical framework to appraise AI outputs brought by families and health systems.

abstract: [British journal of hospital medicine (London, England : 2005)] The application of artificial intelligence (AI) in valvular heart disease (VHD) has advanced significantly in recent years. However, a systematic evaluation of this field's historical development, knowledge structure, and global research patterns has yet to be conducted. This paper aims to outline the global evolution of AI research in VHD utilizing bibliometric and knowledge-mapping methods. Publications related to AI and VHD from 1991 to 2025 were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection database to investigate research progress. CiteSpace software was employed for bibliometric and knowledge mapping analyses, assessing indicators such as publication trends, keyword networks, collaboration patterns, co-citation relationships, and emerging topics. A total of 3291 pieces of literature were identified. Research productivity remained low until the year before 2004, followed by steady growth and a sharp increase after 2015, culminating in 461 articles by the end of 2025. Network analysis revealed three sequential stages: image-assisted applications, prediction modeling, and recent advancements in deep-learning-based integrated systems. The United States accounted for the largest research volume, while England and Germany served as core nodes in the international cooperation network. Co-citation analysis identified significant clinical guidelines and pioneering interventional studies as key intellectual pillars in this domain. Over the past 35 years, significant progress has been achieved, transitioning from computer systems used solely for image analysis to more integrated clinical applications. Currently, deep learning techniques are increasingly prevalent, accompanied by a focus on multimodal data integration and a stronger linkage between computational methods and clinical decision-making.

abstract: [Clinical and experimental dental research] Bitewing radiographs (BWs) are essential diagnostic tools in dentistry, but are often affected by positioning errors, compromising their diagnostic value and increasing retake rates. This study aimed to develop and evaluate a deep learning-based automated system for detecting and classifying BW type (premolar/molar), side (right/left), and common positioning errors in a controlled mannequin-based setting. A total of 403 BWs were collected from dental student assessments acquired from dental radiology mannequins. BWs were consensus-labeled by dentomaxillofacial radiology experts for type, side, and the most common positioning errors. A balanced data set supported training and validation. Convolutional neural network architectures, including ResNet and DenseNet variants, were trained from scratch and evaluated as independent classification tasks using stratified fivefold cross-validation. Performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and area under the curve, reported as mean ± standard deviation across folds. A confusion matrix was generated for multi-class cone-cutting error (CCE) severity classification. The system achieved accuracies of 95.8% for BW type classification, 99.0% for side classification, 96.3% for CCE detection, and 93.4% for interproximal overlap detection. Multi-class CCE classification achieved an accuracy of 79.3%, with reliable identification of "critical" and "minimal" errors. Detection of incorrect receptor placement achieved an accuracy of 73.2%. The CNN-based system showed strong performance for bitewing type, side, binary cone-cutting error, and interproximal overlap classification in mannequin-acquired radiographs. Performance was more limited for multi-class cone-cutting severity and incorrect receptor placement. These findings support the potential use of deep learning for radiographic quality assessment in education and quality-control workflows. A validation study using patient-acquired bitewing radiographs from clinical settings is required before clinical deployment.
zh_abstract:
【背景】咬合翼片（bitewing radiographs，BWs）是牙科中重要的诊断工具，但常受到投照位置错误的影响，从而降低其诊断价值并增加重拍率。本研究旨在开发并评估一种基于深度学习的自动化系统，用于在受控的模型人（mannequin）环境中检测并分类 BW 类型（前磨牙/磨牙）、侧别（右/左）以及常见的投照位置错误。
【方法】共收集 403 张 BW，来自牙科学生考核中使用牙科放射学模型人所获得的影像。BW 由口腔颌面放射学专家就类型、侧别和最常见的投照位置错误达成共识并进行标注。一个平衡的数据集用于训练和验证。包括 ResNet 和 DenseNet 变体在内的卷积神经网络架构从头开始训练，并采用分层五折交叉验证作为独立的分类任务进行评估。性能以准确率、精确率、召回率、F1 分数和曲线下面积进行评估，以各折的平均值±标准差报告。针对多分类的锥形束切割错误（cone-cutting error，CCE）严重程度分类生成了混淆矩阵。
【结果】该系统在 BW 类型分类中的准确率为 95.8%，侧别分类为 99.0%，CCE 检测为 96.3%，邻面重叠检测为 93.4%。多分类 CCE 分类的准确率为 79.3%，可可靠识别“严重”和“轻微”错误。错误接收器放置的检测准确率为 73.2%。
【结论】基于 CNN 的系统在模型人所获影像中对咬合翼片类型、侧别、二分类锥形束切割错误和邻面重叠分类表现良好。对多分类锥形束切割严重程度和错误接收器放置的性能较为有限。这些发现支持深度学习在教学和质量控制流程中用于放射影像质量评估的潜力。在临床部署之前，需要使用临床环境中患者咬合翼片开展验证研究。

abstract: [Southern medical journal] Artificial intelligence (AI) is used increasingly to support clinical care and documentation in health care, including patient rehabilitation. AI is used to increase efficiency, facilitate information transfer, and improve accuracy and consistency in assessment and treatment of medical conditions. AI can assist clinicians in correlating symptoms, tracking patient progress, and recommending evidence-based treatment protocols. This article first provides perspectives on the role of AI in managing lateral epicondylosis. title: Fairness Metrics based on the AUC in Clinical Predictive AI

abstract: Fairness evaluation of clinical prediction models for binary outcomes often involves fairness metrics that compare the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC, or c-statistic) across subgroups. However, the AUC has been shown to be a non-collapsible metric, meaning that its subgroup specific and overall values are not directly comparable as often implicitly assumed. This raises important questions about how existing AUC-based fairness metrics should be used and interpreted. We examine eight AUC-based fairness metrics proposed in the literature, including: within-group AUC parity; cross-group AUC (xAUC) parity; gap-to-overall AUC; equity-scaled AUC; minimum-based metrics; $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$; $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$; and $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$ or $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$ parity. We characterise their estimands, relate them to the decomposition of overall AUC (into within- and cross-group components), and critically appraise them. We then illustrate their behaviour using simulations based on the EuroSCORE II, a clinical prediction model for in-hospital mortality. We recommend reporting an AUC matrix, containing the overall AUC and all within- and cross-group AUC components, alongside population characteristics. When fairness metrics are needed, we recommend reporting the within-group AUC parity, with cross-group AUC parity providing supplementary information but requiring caution due to its potential conflict with calibration. Metrics involving $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$ and $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$ have merit, summarising within- and cross-group AUCs into single values, but their interpretation is non-trivial, and they should be used with caution. Gap-to-overall AUC, equity-scaled AUC, and minimum-based metrics compare quantities that should not be compared and it is unclear how to operationalise them, making them not fit for purpose and generally not recommended.
zh_abstract: 针对二分类结局的临床预测模型的公平性评估，常涉及比较各亚组受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC，即c统计量）的公平性指标。然而，AUC已被证明是一种不可折叠（non-collapsible）的指标，即其亚组特异性值与总体值之间并不能像通常隐含假设的那样直接比较。这对现有基于AUC的公平性指标应如何使用和解释提出了重要问题。我们考察了文献中提出的八种基于AUC的公平性指标，包括：组内AUC均等（within-group AUC parity）；跨组AUC（xAUC）均等；与总体AUC的差距（gap-to-overall AUC）；公平性缩放AUC（equity-scaled AUC）；基于最小值的指标；$\mathrm{xAUC}^1$；$\mathrm{xAUC}^0$；以及$\mathrm{xAUC}^1$或$\mathrm{xAUC}^0$均等。我们刻画了它们的估计目标（estimand），将其与总体AUC的分解（分为组内和跨组成分）联系起来，并进行了批判性评价。随后，我们基于EuroSCORE II（一种院内死亡率临床预测模型）的模拟来说明它们的表现。我们建议报告AUC矩阵，其中包含总体AUC及所有组内和跨组AUC成分，并同时报告人群特征。当需要公平性指标时，我们建议报告组内AUC均等，跨组AUC均等可提供补充信息，但由于其可能与校准相冲突，需谨慎使用。涉及$\mathrm{xAUC}^1$和$\mathrm{xAUC}^0$的指标有一定价值，可将组内和跨组AUC汇总为单一数值，但其解释并不简单，应谨慎使用。与总体AUC的差距、公平性缩放AUC和基于最小值的指标比较的是不应被比较的量，且不清楚如何将其付诸实施，因此不适用，通常不推荐。
