abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] Clinical microbiology laboratories face persistent pressure to shorten turnaround times, reduce manual workloads, and standardize diagnostic workflows. Total laboratory automation (TLA) and artificial intelligence (AI) are complementary responses to these demands. In this review, we examine how the evidence base for automation and AI in clinical microbiology is distributed along a maturity gradient and what this distribution implies for the next phase of implementation. Available evidence indicates that automated platforms shorten culture turnaround times and reduce manual workload in observational and multi-center studies, although the scale of benefit depends on specimen type and workflow configuration. Automated reading, identification, and susceptibility testing systems showed high concordance with manual standards for common specimen types, with error rates below commonly cited acceptability thresholds. Evidence for AI performance in plate reading and resistance prediction is abundant; however, most models remain in an assistive phase without prospective validation. Randomized trials of rapid testing and automation rarely demonstrate overall clinical superiority, and patient-oriented benefits remain limited and inconsistent. Guidelines provide directional support, whereas interoperability, quality control, and regulatory frameworks are still under development. The priority of the field is not additional single-center performance validation. The next phase requires multi-center prospective verification, interpretability, standardization, and comparative evidence with clinical outcomes as endpoints. AI-assisted evidence tools may accelerate evidence generation, although their utility remains preliminary.

title: Dual-VaDE: Efficient and Robust Prototype Learning via Variational Dual-Domain Mixture Priors

abstract: In this paper, we propose Dual-VaDE, an unsupervised generative framework for learning interpretable anatomical prototypes from unlabeled medical images. In contrast to previous variational methods that rely on a single spatial latent code, which often entangles global geometry with local textures and fails to capture their cross-domain dependencies, Dual-VaDE introduces a dual-domain Gaussian mixture prior that explicitly couples spatial anatomy with phase-preserving Fourier spectral representations. We derive an exact, closed-form variational lower bound that fuses this joint prior into the decoder and optimizes the entire network end-to-end via an alternating EM formulation, avoiding heuristic two-stage clustering while ensuring superior training stability and robustness. Evaluated on OASIS-3 brain MRI, Dual-VaDE delivers substantially sharper and more plausible prototypes, achieves superior cluster separation with improvements of up to 94% over spatial-only baselines, exhibits markedly reduced variance across random seeds, and incurs negligible inference overhead (0.28 ms per image).
zh_abstract: 本文提出 Dual-VaDE，一种无监督生成框架，用于从未标注的医学图像中学习可解释的解剖原型。以往的变分方法依赖单一的空间潜变量编码，往往将全局几何结构与局部纹理纠缠在一起，且无法捕捉二者之间的跨域依赖关系；与之不同，Dual-VaDE 引入了双域高斯混合先验，显式地将空间解剖结构与保留相位的傅里叶频谱表示耦合起来。我们推导出一个精确的、闭式的变分下界，将该联合先验融合进解码器，并通过交替 EM 形式对整个网络进行端到端优化，既避免了启发式的两阶段聚类，又确保了更优的训练稳定性和鲁棒性。在 OASIS-3 脑部 MRI 上的评估表明，Dual-VaDE 能生成明显更清晰、更合理的原型，其聚类分离度较仅使用空间域的基线提升最高达 94%，不同随机种子之间的方差显著降低，且推理开销可忽略不计（每幅图像 0.28 ms）。

abstract: [Bioinformatics advances] Amyloids are predominantly β-sheet-rich, stable protein structures that can maintain their presence in the human body for multiple years. Amyloid protein aggregates contribute to the development of multiple neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and Huntington's, and are involved in different vital functions, such as memory formation and immune system function. Here, we used advanced machine learning and deep learning techniques to predict amyloid propensity from the amino acid sequence. First, we aggregated labeled amino acid sequence data from multiple sources, obtaining a roughly balanced dataset of 2365 sequences for binary classification. We leveraged that data to both fine-tune the ESM2 model and to train new models based on protein embeddings from ESM2 and UniRep. The predictions from these models were then unified into a single soft voting ensemble model, yielding highly robust and accurate results. We further made a tool where users can provide the amino acid sequence and get the amyloid formation probabilities of different segments of the input sequence. abstract: [Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology] Craniomaxillofacial subunit transplantation represents one of the most technically demanding reconstructive strategies for repairing anatomical subunit defects involving the cranium, mandible, maxilla, orbital cavity and nose. Conventional reconstructive approaches are hindered by inherent limitations in personalized anatomical matching, dynamic tissue adaptability, and long-term therapeutic efficacy. The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and four-dimensional (4D) bioprinting has revolutionized craniomaxillofacial reconstructive surgery. This review summarizes state-of-the-art advances in AI-enabled 4D bioprinting for craniomaxillofacial subunit repair, covering core application scenarios including bone defect regeneration, facial soft tissue and cutaneous organ reconstruction, peripheral neural regeneration, and vascularized composite tissue fabrication. We elaborate the synergistic potential of AI and 4D bioprinting in craniomaxillofacial subunit reconstruction, and dissect critical bottlenecks including inadequate material performance, low precision of shape deformation programming, and limited clinical translatability of existing AI models. This work provides valuable insights for further translational research of AI-integrated 4D bioprinting in craniomaxillofacial subunit reconstruction.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology] 颅颌面亚单位移植是修复涉及颅骨、下颌骨、上颌骨、眼眶和鼻部的解剖亚单位缺损时技术要求最高的重建策略之一。传统重建方法受限于个体化解剖匹配、动态组织适应性和长期治疗效果方面的固有局限。人工智能（AI）与四维（4D）生物打印的结合已经革新了颅颌面重建外科。本综述总结了AI赋能的4D生物打印用于颅颌面亚单位修复的最新进展，涵盖骨缺损再生、面部软组织和皮肤器官重建、周围神经再生以及带血管复合组织制造等核心应用场景。我们阐述了AI与4D生物打印在颅颌面亚单位重建中的协同潜力，并剖析了关键瓶颈，包括材料性能不足、形状变形编程精度低，以及现有AI模型的临床转化能力有限。本工作为AI整合的4D生物打印在颅颌面亚单位重建中的进一步转化研究提供了有价值的见解。
